noteGrp.note: The Pauline Epistles (Peshitta version) are extant in numerous manuscripts, the earliest of which date to the the 5th-6th century. In manuscripts containing the entire New Testament, the Pauline Epistles are sometimes placed after Acts and the Catholic Epistles or sometimes immediately after the Four Gospels.
